title: South garden terrace: pergola, climbers, centrepiece and seating
caption_notes: South terrace from the open east-yard approach: timber pergola with Petrea and star jasmine, planted centrepiece, bench and two lounge chairs. Authored botanical/furniture appearances and pergola dimensions are assumed; structure, roots and procurement remain unverified.
